name: Saiminbo
source:
The main character Souichi Chiba used to live with his father in a motherless household but since his father passed away two years ago he's come to live alone. His mother died when he was born and now he's left without any relatives. Because of this he has a powerful longing for someone to call a mother. Even though he has no mother, he's come down with a serious mother complex.

Minami Koube, his doctor and long time confidant, once said to him, "If you want a mom that much, there is an interesting way, you know?". He went along with her suggestion and began working toward getting a mother using the technique of hypnotism...

[Translated from [url=http://www.fudegaki.jp/saiminbo/story.html]Fudegaki Soft's product page[/url]]
translation:
主角千叶宗一曾经和父亲一起生活在一个没有母亲的家庭里，但自从两年前父亲去世后，他就开始独自生活。他的母亲在他出生时就去世了，现在他没有任何亲人。正因为如此，他有一种强烈的渴望，渴望有人叫一声母亲。尽管他没有母亲，但他却有着严重的母亲情结。

他的医生兼长期知己南古部曾对他说：“如果你那么想要一个妈妈，有一个有趣的方法，你知道吗？”。他同意了她的建议，并开始努力利用催眠术来找回母亲……

[翻译自[url=http://www.fudegaki.jp/saiminbo/story.html]Fudegaki Soft的产品页面[/url]]
